name: How do I know if my stair needs repair or a full replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my stair needs repair or a full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining whether your stairs need repair or full replacement depends on the extent of structural damage, safety concerns, and overall condition. Minor issues like loose treads or worn finishes can often be repaired cost-effectively. However, if there is widespread structural rot, significant insect damage, or irreparable foundational issues, a full replacement may be the safer and more economical long-term solution. Frasheski Construction can assess your stairs in the Berkeley and East Bay areas to provide an expert recommendation based on structural integrity and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decide between stair repair or replacement based on structural damage extent and safety. Minor issues are repairable; widespread rot or foundational issues may require replacement. We provide expert assessment.
